site.label: Site
site.description: Site name or ID used for clock-in, e.g. Homeoffice. May stay empty if the account has only one site.

button.label: Button
button.description: Physical button used to clock in, pause and clock out

poll_interval.label: Refresh, seconds
poll_interval.description: How often the status is fetched from clockin.de. The time on screen keeps counting in between.
